verdict.rationale: Exa's docs show a per-query 'search type' selector with different latency-quality profiles, from ~250 ms instant search to 12-40 s deep-reasoning search, and output_schema works with any search type. However, the evidence never says these types map to keyword, neural, or hybrid retrieval, so only the per-query mode-selection part of the story is supported. Missing for 10: documented keyword/lexical mode, documented neural/embedding mode, documented hybrid mode, and hands-on corroboration of mode switching.
